acceptance: Before any network request or output creation, the runner admits its 160000000-byte local allocation against the shared 4000000000-byte work limit.
Every source descriptor and component is received only from its declared HTTPS Ubuntu pool URL, without redirect, and matches its exact declared byte count and SHA-256 before use.
The signed descriptor content declares the same source/version and SHA-256 component map; archive members and links are safety-inspected before dpkg-source unpacks into isolated fresh directories.
The receipt binds runtime and development package Source/Version fields and streams each retained runtime package payload member to the selected provider ELF SHA-256.
The runner preserves all source archives, descriptors, source-tree maps and failure receipts. It makes no build or reproducibility claim.
scope: Acquire six exact, hash-pinned Ubuntu source descriptor/component archives into a fresh isolated work directory, inspect every tar path/link before unpacking, and retain source-tree and binary-package-to-selected-ELF identities. No build, package installation, host apt change, or release operation occurs.
